cause: The newly pinned full-size GEMM fixture was inside the four tiny legacy PTX fixtures directory. Both legacy directory-enumerating tests sent it to Task.parse, whose existing <=256thread/4096cell guard correctly refused it. Dedicated full-source GEMM CI passed.
correction: Move all5 full-size GEMM input files byte-identically from cases/full-size-gemm to full-size/gemm and update documentation, frontend fixture and the dedicated CI command paths. The four bounded cases and generic legacy tests are retained.
scope: Failed source CI is retained. A new corrected source commit must pass its own fresh workflow; the failed workflow is never relabeled successful.
